name: Microsoft Clarity Data Export
description: The Microsoft Clarity Data Export API enables users to download their Clarity dashboard data programmatically for advanced analysis and system integration. Returns dashboard insights (traffic, engagement time, scroll depth, dead/rage/error clicks, script errors, and more) as JSON over the last 1-3 days, broken down by up to three dimensions (Browser, Device, Country/Region, OS, Source, Medium, Campaign, Channel, URL). Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/clarity/setup-and-installation/clarity-data-export-api
